title: Sting: read like a detective
idea: Reading closely turns a full stop into a clue: the smallest mark on the page becomes the whole world.

beats.buys: this is about reading, said with weight
beats.moves: four words rise on uneven gaps (4, 3, 6 f), the first already mid-rise on frame 0, softLand 12 f, vertical smear 14 px halving
beats.carries: the headline stays; only its tint settles
the accent full stop stays put while its words leave, then grows into the next ground (T3)

beats.moves: words exit up with accelExit 13 f; bead grows in log space to cover the frame (crashOut 18 f)
beats.carries: the accent colour is now the ground

beats.moves: magnifier ring whips in from 0.6 W (7 f) with horizontal smear
beats.carries: the ring stays; the camera punches in on it

beats.moves: one-frame camera punch to 0.74x, softLand tail, decaying shake; words resolve by blur focus 4 f each; one popOver dock; lockup still shrinking at the last frame
